text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا نَصِيرٍۢ

words.gloss_range: resumptive/coordinating conjunction attached to the opening negation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation and fresh address at once. It binds the denial of escape to the prior accountability frame without reducing the relation to a simple cause-effect link, and its fused launch with the following negator makes linkage and denial arrive together. The repeated opening pattern from 42:30 into 42:31 lets the warning feel argued from what preceded it rather than detached.

topics.headline: resumptive opening into negated address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the escape denial continues the accountability argument and simultaneously turns it into direct address.
topics.reason: QAC allows the prefixed conjunction to resume or coordinate the negated clause, and the CRITICAL rows converge on continuity, fused opening form, and boundary linkage with 42:30.

words.gloss_range: negating particle over a nominal pronoun-participle clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates a nominal status, not just a single failed attempt. Because it governs the explicit subject and the participial predicate, the addressees are excluded from the class of frustrators. Its lengthened written form gives negation audible weight, and the first negation frame prepares the later matching frame of denied support.

topics.headline: nominal status cancellation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is not merely stopped once; the identity of being frustrators is denied of them.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as governing the nominal clause, and attachment evidence confirms the negation over the pronoun-participle predication with the earth phrase locating the denial.

topics.headline: first negative frame prepares the second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first sustained negation as the opening panel of a two-panel structure: denied evasion followed by denied support.
topics.reason: The formal rows about the written lengthening and first frame are compatible with the clause evidence and remain useful as structural payoff.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person plural subject made explicit under negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: later second-person possessive phrase cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}) makes the addressed group a full surface word before the denied status appears. The pronoun prevents the warning from floating as a general maxim: the same addressees carried over from 42:30 are held in view, then stripped of the claim to be uncatchable. Its later counterpart in {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) keeps the confrontation on the same audience.

topics.headline: explicit second-person subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial lands on the addressees themselves rather than on a vague human condition.
topics.reason: QAC marks an independent second-person masculine plural pronoun as subject; the rows coherently preserve explicit address, iltifat, and exposed subject order.

topics.headline: same audience carried across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 42:31 turn the prior moral explanation into confrontation with the same implicated audience.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are supported by the explicit second-person subject here and by the later second-person possessive phrase in the same ayah.

words.gloss_range: predicate-marking preposition under negation, attached to the active participle

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following participial predicate cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks the participial predicate inside the negated nominal clause. Its attachment to {{ar:مُعْجِزِينَ}} ({{tr:muʿjizīna}}) tightens the denied status to the addressees and makes the predicate arrive as a marked construction rather than a loose description. The local effect is grammatical strengthening of the status-denial, not a new independent topic.

topics.headline: predicate marker under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refused role is grammatically bonded to the addressees as a denied predicate, not merely appended as a description.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the preposition as attached to the participial predicate under negation; the lexical attachment and reinforcing force survive as local predicate-marking payoff.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle: would-be frustrators or those making another unable, here denied as a plural status
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes inability, weakness, lagging behind, and causing incapacity; local Form IV selects frustrating or rendering unable

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following prepositional domain phrase cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:مُعْجِزِينَ}} ({{tr:muʿjizīna}}) is a plural Form IV active participle, so the ayah denies a role of frustrating pursuit or making another unable, not simply a momentary weakness. The object is left unstated, widening the failed frustration toward divine reach, command, judgment, and accountability. Its root field turns the escape fantasy inside out: creatures marked by incapacity cannot export that incapacity onto Allah's reach. Positioned before {{ar:فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:fī al-arḍi}}), the claimed capacity is named first and then spatially enclosed; parallels such as 29:22 and 46:32 show this as a recognizable failed-evasion register, while 42:30 prevents divine pardon from being misread as inability to pursue.

topics.headline: Form IV participial frustrator role denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word denies the status of being people who can frustrate pursuit, with no single object limiting the failed frustration.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form IV active participle predicate, attachment evidence places it under negation with predicate-marking {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), and the objectless form leaves the target of frustration broad.

topics.headline: incapacity reversed against the escape claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the irony that the root field of incapacity frames the very people imagining themselves able to make judgment powerless.
topics.reason: V4-compatible root evidence supports the range from inability to causative making-unable, while the local Form IV participle selects the causative frustration branch.

topics.headline: failed evasion joined to earthly domain and support denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-step no-exit movement: self-evasion fails in the earth, then external patronage and rescue also fail.
topics.reason: The following prepositional phrase is syntactically attached as the domain of the denied participle, and the CRITICAL rows' parallels with 29:22 and the local support pair are not contradicted.

topics.headline: pardon does not imply divine inability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 42:30's pardon is generosity, not evidence that the addressees can evade accountability.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the explicit status-denial in the first clause and preserve a real transition from prior pardon to present inescapability.

words.gloss_range: preposition of containment and domain, governing the earth phrase
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the denial into a domain-tested claim. The preposition governs the following earth noun and attaches to the denied participle, so the earth is not a separate scene but the sphere in which uncatchability collapses. Its short governed phrase closes the first denial cleanly before the second negation frame begins.

topics.headline: earth-domain attached to failed evasion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is the field where the escape claim is tested and denied, not neutral scenery.
topics.reason: QAC marks a preposition governing the earth noun, and attachment evidence makes the phrase a complement locating the denied participial predicate.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive earth noun as the governed domain of failed evasion
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers land, ground, territory, and earth; local definiteness widens it to the known terrestrial arena

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governing preposition cited in the prose
preceding denied participle cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) names the known terrestrial arena in which escape fails. Governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), it is contained field rather than destination or source, and its definite singular form treats the earth as one comprehensive domain rather than scattered possible territories. The immediate adjacency to {{ar:مُعْجِزِينَ}} ({{tr:muʿjizīna}}) makes terrain answer the escape claim, while the recited liaison binds the preposition and earth noun into one domain phrase whose closure pressure reaches toward the final support nouns. Parallels such as 29:22 and 2:107 keep the movement from earth to denied patronage recognizable.

topics.headline: definite earth as comprehensive arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial covers the known inhabited earth as a whole, not one local territory that leaves another route open.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite concrete noun in genitive after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), and the rows' definiteness and singular-domain claims fit the local governed phrase.

topics.headline: earth as field of failed uncatchability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the earth phrase as the very field where claimed uncatchability is disproved.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence connects the noun to the denied participle, and contextual pair evidence licenses the escape-field pressure without making earth an independent actor.

topics.headline: earth pivots into support denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural turn: after the earth closes spatial evasion, the ayah pivots to the loss of protector and helper.
topics.reason: The word stands at the end of the first clause before the second negation frame, and the cited parallels such as 29:22 and 2:107 support the domain-to-support movement.

topics.headline: recited domain phrase as a bound unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the earth phrase as tightly joined to the first denial and acoustically linked to the final support nouns.
topics.reason: The prosodic rows add a modest but concrete payoff about liaison and ending pressure, consistent with the syntactic dependence of the phrase.

words.gloss_range: coordinating/resumptive conjunction opening the second negation frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: local conjunction-plus-negator frame cited in the prose

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens a parallel negative frame after the earth phrase has closed the first one. It coordinates with the failed-evasion clause while resuming a fresh possessive construction, shifting from what the addressees cannot be to what they do not have. The repeated {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-mā}}) shape makes the ayah sound like matched panels: no escape, and no support.

topics.headline: pivot into parallel support denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins a second complete denial rather than tacking on an afterthought.
topics.reason: QAC marks the conjunction as beginning the second negation frame, and clause evidence confirms a coordinated second nominal clause.

topics.headline: paired frames close two exits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the architecture of two closed routes: self-evasion first, then substitute support.
topics.reason: The synthesis row is supported by the two explicit negation frames and by the later denied support nouns.

words.gloss_range: negating particle in a possessive/existential construction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following possessive phrase cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates available support in an existential-possessive frame. With {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}), it denies not merely that a protector exists somewhere, but that any such support exists for the addressees or stands on their side. It mirrors the first negator while changing the predicate type from denied status to denied possession.

topics.headline: support unavailable for the addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second clause removes usable support from the addressees, not just an abstract protector from the world.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle in an existential/possessive construction with {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}), and attachment support says the repeated negation and partitive particles deny any protector or helper category.

topics.headline: second negation mirrors and changes the first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the parallel frame while noticing the shift from what they cannot be to what they cannot have.
topics.reason: The formal contrast between the two negators is coherent with the two-clause architecture.

words.gloss_range: fronted possessive or benefactive phrase with second-person plural suffix

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier explicit second-person subject cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) brings the lack of support onto the addressees' side before any support noun is named. The preposition and suffix compress possession, benefit, and alignment: no patron belongs to them, benefits them, or stands for them. The same audience named by {{ar:أَنتُم}} ({{tr:antum}}) now appears as denied beneficiary or possessor, so capacity and support are both removed from the same group.

topics.headline: fronted possession and benefit denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause first frames the addressees' lack, then names the missing support categories.
topics.reason: QAC marks a prepositional phrase with a second-person plural suffix, and attachment evidence treats the suffix relation as the possessor for the denied support noun.

topics.headline: same group moves from subject to possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same addressees lose both what they can be and what can be for them.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix is local evidence for continuity with the earlier independent second-person pronoun, while the grammar changes their role from subject to possessive/benefactive party.

words.gloss_range: source/separation preposition introducing the exclusion phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following exclusion phrase cited in the prose
later exhaustive particle cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:مِّن}} ({{tr:min}}) is the first of two min-particles in the support clause. Here it marks source and separation by introducing {{ar:دُونِ ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:dūni Allāhi}}), so the ayah asks from what outside source substitute protection could come and closes that domain before the protector class is named. Its role differs from the later exhaustive {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), giving the denial a layered architecture.

topics.headline: first min closes the substitute source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the support denial first blocks the source of imagined help before it exhausts the helper class.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place this preposition before the exclusion phrase, while the rows distinguish its source/separation force from the later class-exhausting particle.

words.gloss_range: construct exclusion noun/adverbial governed by source-marking min
words.root_gloss_range: root range carries below, short of, apart from, and lesser-than pressure; local phrase selects excluded substitute-source

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct complement cited in the prose
following patron noun cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) is bound in construct to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), so the exclusion is measured against a named divine reference point. Its below, short-of, and apart-from pressures make non-divine support not merely alternative but lower, outside, and insufficient. Because the phrase stands before {{ar:وَلِىٍّۢ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}), the ayah blocks the imagined source of patronage before it denies the patron class itself; parallels such as 2:107 and 29:22 keep this inside a wider substitute-support formula.

topics.headline: construct exclusion measured by the divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exclusion is not vague otherness; it is specifically defined relative to Allah.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}) as a construct form with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) as genitive complement.

topics.headline: below and apart pressure within local exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels substitute protection demoted as below, apart from, and short of the divine reference point, while the local phrase still means exclusion rather than a separate doctrine of lowness.
topics.reason: The d-w-n semantic range supports below/apart/short-of pressure; the d-y-n dispute is kept only as subordinate color and does not replace the local d-w-n exclusion sense.

topics.headline: formula targets false patronage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase is not abstract polemic; it aims the no-substitute formula at the patronage being denied here.
topics.reason: The rows' formulaic and same-surah claims are supported by contextual pairings with Allah and patronage and by the local attachment to the denied support noun.

topics.headline: source boundary before class noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the support clause arranged so the source boundary stands between audience need and the named protector.
topics.reason: The local word order places the exclusion phrase before the protector noun and between {{ar:لَكُم}} ({{tr:lakum}}) and the denied support class.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive as the complement that fixes the exclusion boundary
words.root_gloss_range: root discussions include worship, devotion, refuge, and need-turning; locally the proper name functions as the unique divine reference point

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct head cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) fixes the unique reference point for the whole support denial. As the genitive complement of {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}), the divine name governs how the coming protector and helper nouns are heard: the ayah denies support from outside Allah, not help in the abstract. The broader worship, refuge, and need-turning pressure remains subordinate to the proper name, but it makes the search for outside patronage feel relationally impossible. The proper name stands between exclusion and patronage, turning the support clause around divine authority; 42:9's statement of Allah as patron becomes here a direct warning that no alternative patron is available.

topics.headline: proper divine name as exclusion boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the support denial is measured by the named divine source, not by a vague hierarchy of helpers.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the proper noun in genitive as complement of {{ar:دُونِ}} ({{tr:dūni}}), and attachment evidence makes it the construct complement that fixes the exclusion boundary.

topics.headline: refuge and need-turning pressure under the proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses why substitute patronage is relationally impossible when the clause is about where people turn for refuge, while the local grammar remains the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The broader ʾ-l-h and derivational discussions are relevant as semantic pressure, but the local evidence selects the proper name as grammatical boundary rather than deriving a new lexical sense.

topics.headline: Allah anchors both denied support modes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patronage and rescue cannot be detached from divine authority in the final support pair.
topics.reason: The divine name stands immediately before the denied support nouns within a total-denial construction, and the co-occurrence rows align with local patronage and rescue terms.

topics.headline: divine name centers the support clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 42:9's divine patronage claim converted into the present audience-facing exclusion of alternatives.
topics.reason: The rows' positional and echo claims are supported by the local order and by concrete references to 42:9 within the same surah.

words.gloss_range: exhaustive or partitive min before an indefinite denied support noun
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) is the second min-particle, now placed before the indefinite patron noun. Under negation it exhausts the class: not even one protector from the non-divine domain remains. Because it follows the source-exclusion phrase, the clause moves from no outside source to no member of the patron class, then onward to the renewed denial of rescue.

topics.headline: second min empties the protector class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar denies any instance of the protector class, not merely a known or named patron.
topics.reason: QAC marks this preposition before an indefinite support noun, and attachment support describes it as extra/partitive min strengthening negation.

topics.headline: source exclusion to class exhaustion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the support denial built in layers: source boundary, class exhaustion, then renewed helper negation.
topics.reason: The row is locally licensed by the sequence of particles in the support clause and by the following denied support nouns.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive protector or patron noun under exhaustive negation
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes nearness, charge, allegiance, guardianship, and protective patronage; local sense selects standing non-divine patronage as denied

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governing exhaustive particle cited in the prose
later helper noun cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:وَلِىٍّۢ}} ({{tr:waliyyin}}) is the first denied support noun. Indefinite, singular, and governed by exhaustive {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), it removes even one non-divine patron from availability. The root's nearness and charge field makes the denied relation more than friendship: it is standing protective authority. Its position before {{ar:نَصِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) matters, because the ayah first closes ongoing patronage and then closes active rescue; 42:9 names Allah as the patron, while 42:31 exposes every outside patron as unavailable. Against 42:30, what the addressees have earned cannot be shifted onto another patron.

topics.headline: not even one protector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the totality of the denial: no unnamed or minimal patron remains outside the divine boundary.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite genitive noun after {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), and attachment evidence places it in the denied possessive construction.

topics.headline: near patronage, not mere friendship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied support is a standing protective relation of nearness and charge, distinct from later emergency intervention.
topics.reason: The root range supports nearness, charge, alliance, and guardianship, while the local phrase after failed escape selects protective patronage.

topics.headline: relation denied before rescue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final pair as ordered: first no standing patron, then no rescuer to compensate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the later helper with this noun, and the CRITICAL rows correctly preserve the role distinction and order.

topics.headline: same-surah no-protector refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same-surah protection discourse tightening here into direct exclusion of alternatives, especially against 42:9, 42:44, and 42:46.
topics.reason: The echo rows give concrete references and are compatible with the local support-denial construction.

topics.headline: earned liability cannot move to another patron
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that what was earned in 42:30 cannot be absorbed by an alternate patron in 42:31.
topics.reason: The boundary synthesis is locally grounded in the direct second-person denial of patron and helper after the prior accountability frame.

words.gloss_range: conjunction in the closing wa-la unit, coordinating the second support noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: local conjunction-plus-negator unit cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) in the closing {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}) unit coordinates the helper noun with the patron noun without collapsing them. It adds the second support mode inside the same field, while the following negator gives that second mode its own cancellation. The conjunction is therefore the hinge from standing patronage to active rescue.

topics.headline: wa joins but distinguishes support modes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patron and helper form one support field but remain distinct categories.
topics.reason: QAC marks the conjunction before {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), and attachment evidence coordinates the final helper with the patron noun.

topics.headline: connector and negator fused at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final support category enter as both added and already denied.
topics.reason: The formal rows about the fused closing unit are compatible with the separate grammatical jobs of coordination and renewed negation.

words.gloss_range: renewed negator before the final helper noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier negating particle cited in the prose
earlier exhaustive particle cited in the prose
following helper noun cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews negation directly before the final helper noun. It does not let rescue be canceled only by implication from the earlier {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) and {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}); it names active help as a separately denied category. That separation keeps {{ar:نَصِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) distinct from patronage and shapes the ayah's landing as cancellation of rescue.

topics.headline: rescue independently canceled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that active rescue is not left as a loophole after patronage has been denied.
topics.reason: QAC marks a negating particle before the final noun, and attachment evidence treats the final helper as coordinated with the patron while separately introduced by {{ar:وَلَا}} ({{tr:wa-lā}}).

topics.headline: support nouns separated rather than merged
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that helper is not an adjective folded into patron; it is a second support class denied on its own terms.
topics.reason: The rows correctly preserve the compact written unit while maintaining the independent force of the second negator.

words.gloss_range: indefinite intensive helper/rescuer noun under renewed negation
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes aid, defense, support, victory, and rescue; local form names active intervention as denied

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preceding renewed negator cited in the prose

words.prose: {{ar:نَصِيرٍۢ}} ({{tr:naṣīrin}}) closes the ayah on denied rescue. Genitive and coordinated in the same support frame, it remains tied to the earlier patron noun, but {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) gives active help its own explicit cancellation. Its singular indefinite intensive form denies even one role-bearing rescuer, and its root field of aid, defense, and victory makes the last support option an intervention agent rather than standing patronage. The final position matters: after no earth-bound escape and no patron outside Allah, the last semantic landing is no rescuer; parallels such as 2:107 and 29:22, plus the contrast with self-defense language at 42:39, keep the closure formula sharp.

topics.headline: final helper in the same denied support frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun completes the same support inventory while receiving its own explicit negation.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite intensive noun/adjective coordinated under negation, and attachment evidence joins it to the patron as a second denied helper.

topics.headline: active rescuer, defender, and helper denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final term removes crisis intervention, not merely another standing relationship.
topics.reason: The n-ṣ-r root and faʿīl-like form support aid, defense, victory, and role-bearing help; the local pairing with patronage selects active rescue/intervention.

topics.headline: not even one rescuer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees total denial operating from the smallest possible instance: no single unnamed rescuer remains.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite form under negation and the shared tanwin cadence with the patron noun preserve the class-denial payoff.

topics.headline: known no-protector-no-helper closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a familiar formula of failed support after failed escape, while 42:39 distinguishes denied outside rescue from later self-defense language.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references such as 2:107, 29:22, and 42:39, and the local pair with patronage supports the formulaic closure.

topics.headline: ayah lands on failed intervention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the progressive enclosure: no evasion in earth, no patron outside Allah, and finally no rescuer.
topics.reason: The final noun position and the two-clause architecture support the no-exit synthesis without needing any fallback route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ: the Form IV participle is bounded by the terrestrial locative.
baseline_models.mechanism: The failure-and-escape branch of ع ج ز supplies a pursuit relation: humans cannot make the pursuer fail by getting beyond reach. The earth branch supplies the whole lower realm as the arena of that failed evasion.

activation_trace.role: Failure to catch, being outstripped, and escape from pursuit turn generic incapacity into inability to evade.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the bounded field across which escape is denied.

changed_reading.before: You are not powerful enough on earth.
changed_reading.after: Nowhere in the terrestrial field can you outstrip divine reach or make its pursuit fail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ: repeated مِن and the coordinated pair ولي / نصير.
baseline_models.mechanism: دون excludes an alternative locus. ولي contributes continuing nearness and administration, while نصير contributes help mobilized against a threat. The pair closes both durable custody and event-specific rescue.

activation_trace.role: Otherness supplies the excluded alternative sphere from which protection might be sought.
Standing over an affair supplies sustained custodial governance, not merely affection.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the emergency-intervention pole of the pair.

changed_reading.before: You have no friend or helper besides God.
changed_reading.after: Outside God there is neither an enduring authority who can take charge nor an intervening force that can reverse the threat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of دُونِ ٱللَّهِ and وَلِىٍّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: دون can picture something near yet short of the goal, whereas ولي can picture nearness without an interval. Their juxtaposition makes the substitute protector structurally incapable of closing the final protective gap.

activation_trace.role: Nearness that remains below or short of the goal supplies the incomplete approach.
Nearness without a separating interval supplies the protective contact the substitute cannot attain.

changed_reading.before: A protector other than God is unavailable.
changed_reading.after: Any would-be intermediary remains short of the point where protective nearness becomes effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus denial sits inside a causal chain: acquired acts issue in a calamity that reaches its target, the same earning can end in wreck and inextricable entrapment, and the sequence closes with no evasive turn. معجزين therefore concerns consequences that remain able to catch their agents.

activation_trace.role: Escape from a pursuer supplies the focus mechanism to be causally specified.
An affliction that hits a person makes the pursuing consequence concrete.
Acquisition by action supplies the causal link between human agency and what catches it.
The repeated earning relation carries the same causal link into the wrecking alternative.
Entrapment from which one cannot extricate oneself supplies the terminal state of failed evasion.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the escape maneuver explicitly denied at the sequence's close.

structural_cues: 42:30 places earned calamity immediately before the focus; 42:34-35 repeat earning, destruction, and the absence of an evasive turn.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence of earning, impact, entrapment, and no swerve; I infer that the earned consequence is what cannot be outrun. A live alternative is that these merely exemplify divine power without making consequence the pursued object.

changed_reading.before: Humans cannot escape a superior power.
changed_reading.after: Humans cannot outrun the consequences their own acts set into the divinely governed field, even though the preceding pardon clause limits simple retribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after في الأرض, vessels traverse the sea only while wind-enabled motion continues; that motion can be removed and the vessels left fixed after movement. The apparent land locative expands into the entire earthly domain, including its broadest route of geographic flight.

activation_trace.role: The lower realm supplies a domain broader than dry soil alone.
Flowing movement supplies the attempted mobility across that domain.
Wide abundant water supplies the seemingly open alternative to terrestrial confinement.
Wind supplies the enabling force on which maritime escape depends.
Removal of motion shows that the mobility channel remains governed.
Stillness after movement supplies the visible arrest of an attempted traverse.

structural_cues: 42:31 is followed directly by 42:32-34, a motion, immobilization, or destruction sequence on the sea.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earth, sea travel, wind, and arrested motion; I infer that sea travel tests and fails as a geographic exception to في الأرض. The alternative is an analogy rather than a semantic widening of أرض.

changed_reading.before: There is no escape while one remains on land.
changed_reading.after: There is no geographic outside within the created earthly domain: even the open sea and its moving vessels remain inside the reach being denied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Keys governing access, capacity to regather dispersed creatures, and explicit sovereignty turn the earth from neutral terrain into administered jurisdiction. Non-evasion follows not just from superior speed but from one authority controlling entry, dispersion, and recollection.

activation_trace.role: The terrestrial realm supplies the jurisdiction being administratively redescribed.
Keys that preserve and open what lies beneath supply controlled access to the realm.
Gathering what was dispersed supplies recall after apparent spatial diffusion.
Sovereignty supplies the jurisdictional basis for access control and regathering.

structural_cues: The possession formula for heavens and earth occurs at 42:4 and 42:49, enclosing the focus within the same ownership claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies keys, gathering, sovereignty, and repeated possession; I infer a single administered domain whose owner can recollect what scatters. The alternative is that these are separate power predicates without an access-control mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Escape fails because God is stronger everywhere.
changed_reading.after: Escape fails because the whole field is owned and keyed by the same authority that can regather whatever disperses within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly permits transmission while withholding custody: the messenger is not the guarding agent or one charged with their affair, yet he is sent to convey, and sending itself occurs by permission. من دون الله therefore excludes autonomous delegated sovereignty, not every created instrument.

activation_trace.role: Other-than-ness supplies the autonomy test applied to secondary agents.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the authority specifically not transferred.
Guarding is assigned to God in the same verse that denies the messenger custodial agency.
Standing over an affair as sufficient keeper is explicitly withheld from the messenger.
Sending preserves a real commissioned action without granting protective sovereignty.
Delivery of the message defines the limited function retained by the commissioned agent.
Permission marks mediation as authorized and derivative rather than outside God.

structural_cues: 42:6 and 42:48 pair denial of messenger custody with preservation of warning or conveyance; 42:51 makes mediated sending permission-dependent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied custody, retained conveyance, and authorized sending; I infer that دون marks independent jurisdiction rather than mere creaturely mediation. A live alternative is that دون only names false objects of reliance without articulating a general delegation rule.

changed_reading.before: No person or intermediary can have any effective role.
changed_reading.after: Created agents can transmit and act by authorization, but none becomes an autonomous guardian outside the authority that commissioned them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later social sequence retains consultation and the wronged person's انتصار, then regulates when a legal path lies against someone. This prevents نصير in the focus from erasing secondary human defense; what is denied is rescue capable of overriding ultimate accountability.

activation_trace.role: General aid and prevailing supplies the apparently absolute denial that context refines.
Extracting judgment through mutual consultation supplies legitimate collective agency.
Vindication of the wronged supplies a permitted form of derivative defensive action.
Repeated self-vindication confirms that the focus does not deny every worldly exercise of defense.
A traversable legal path supplies the regulated claim that is absent against justified defenders.

structural_cues: 42:38-42 moves from consultation to defense, pardon, and allocation of the legal path against aggressors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legitimate consultation, vindication, and regulated recourse; I infer a distinction between horizontal means and a helper who defeats final jurisdiction. انتصار may be strictly self-redress rather than third-party help, but either reading blocks a total denial of secondary agency.

changed_reading.before: No human help or defense is real in any sense.
changed_reading.after: Worldly consultation and vindication remain real and regulated, but they cannot become an independent rescue from final divine jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late sequence decomposes evasion into three failed operations: return to an earlier state, find a route away, or enter a refuge. This extends the focus's spatial non-evasion into temporal irreversibility and terminal exposure.

activation_trace.role: Escape from pursuit supplies the general operation that later verses decompose.
Return to a prior place or state supplies the reversal sought after exposure.
An extended traversable road supplies the hoped-for route of reversal.
The day with no return closes temporal reversal, not only spatial flight.
Taking shelter in a refuge supplies the final protective alternative explicitly removed.

structural_cues: 42:44 asks for a road of return; 42:46 removes a path; 42:47 removes both return and refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed return, route, and refuge; I infer that 42:31 anticipates an eschatological closure of both space and time. The alternative is that the later sequence restates only judgment-day helplessness without modifying the earlier earthly scope.

changed_reading.before: One cannot flee God's reach in present earthly space.
changed_reading.after: One can neither flee spatially now nor reverse, reroute, or shelter once the terminal day arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates remote material branches of ولي and نصر. It remains anchored in the focus's earth-protector-helper triad and is unusually reinforced by 42:28, where literal rain, revived growth, mercy, and al-Wali coincide. Render it only as an ecological resonance, not as a replacement translation of ولي or نصير.

activation_trace.role: Soft sprouting land supplies the recipient whose life depends on arriving rain.
Rain following the first seasonal rain supplies a remote sequence-of-care overtone to the protector.
Rain as aid and relief supplies a material rescue image for the helper.
Relief of the afflicted activates the rescue side of the explicit rain event.
Aid at a moment of hardship preserves the non-dominant mapped root's help image.
Dried pasture revived by rain supplies the earthward effect of the rescue.
Calling God al-Wali at the close of the rain-and-mercy verse activates the follow-on-rain branch in context.

changed_reading.before: No independent protector or helper exists on earth.
changed_reading.after: At the material edge of the wording, no independent patronage-rain or rescue-rain can keep earth alive; the sequence of fertility and relief remains under God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This kinetic diagram is surprising because finish-line possession and arrival-at-land are form-distant branches of ولي and نصر. It remains anchored in معجزين and is activated by prior precedence, running vessels, and their arrest. Render it as a branch-induced race image, not as the lexical sense of the clause.

activation_trace.role: Outstripping a pursuer supplies the race frame.
Reaching the goal and taking possession supplies the finish-line function denied to a substitute patron.
Arrival at a land supplies the rescuer who would have to reach the stranded runner.
Precedence and racing place the governing word already ahead.
The running vessels embody attempted forward transit.
Stillness after motion arrests the race before any imagined finish.

changed_reading.before: Humans cannot escape and have no helper.
changed_reading.after: The clause can be pictured as a failed race: the governing decree is already ahead, earthly motion can be stopped, and no substitute reaches the goal or arrives to retrieve the stranded.

strongest_changes: The 42:30-35 chain turns abstract incapacity into earned consequences that strike, immobilize, entrap, and leave no evasive turn.
The 42:44-47 chain extends non-evasion from earthly space into no return, no route, and no refuge.
Messenger and communal action remain real but derivative, so the focus denies autonomous protection rather than every mediated form of agency.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet kept several mechanisms distinct: sovereign access control, land-sea mobility, causal pursuit, delegated agency, lawful vindication, and terminal closure. Its sharpest odd activation was the rain-rescue overlap among earth, wali, nasir, and 42:28.
remaining_uncertainties: The sea sequence may analogically test the earth claim rather than semantically widen أرض to include sea.
The rain branches may be a deliberate material resonance or only a productive lexical coincidence.
The late no-return sequence may deepen 42:31 eschatologically or simply restate helplessness in a later setting.
The دون / ولي proximity contrast is structurally neat but remains branch-sensitive and exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Terrestrial range cannot become escape from pursuit.** Lexical evidence: ع ج ز `B002` (escape/outstripping pursuit) and `B001` (falling short), ء ر ض `B001` (lower ground), د و ن `B003` (besides), و ل ي `B004` (support), and ن ص ر `B001` (aid that makes prevail). Structural cue and role: **فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ** sets the largest available human field, then both escape and alternate support are negated. Abductive move: I infer that spatial mobility cannot exceed the authority already said to own and measure that field. Reading change: inability is not generic weakness; it is failure to outrun a comprehensive jurisdiction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:44–47 repeatedly deny patron, road, return, and refuge. Those later negations made escape here the first statement of a sustained route-collapse sequence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The wide earth is not an escape field.** **Lexical evidence:** ع ج ز `B002` (escape, outstripping, and eluding pursuit), ء ر ض `B001` (lower ground), and س ب ل-like escape logic supplied later by the window, anchored in بِمُعْجِزِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ. **Structural cue:** 42:29 says dispersed creatures remain gatherable; 42:32-34 move onto the broad sea yet retain dependence on wind; 42:35 concludes that disputants have no مَحِيص. **Assigned role:** the earth supplies apparent room for flight, while the eluding branch denies that spatial breadth creates causal escape. **Abductive move:** I infer that changing location cannot change one's position in the gathering and consequence system. **Reading change:** عدم الإعجاز means failure to outmaneuver, not merely lack of superior power.
2. **Neither durable affiliation nor event-specific aid survives outside authority.** **Lexical evidence:** و ل ي `B004` (loyal alliance and support) and ن ص ر `B001` (aid that makes someone prevail), both negated after مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ. **Structural cue:** the pair repeats 42:8, but now follows gathering and earned impact; 42:35-36 contrast no escape with reliance on God. **Assigned role:** ولي supplies sustained relational backing, while نصير supplies help at the crisis point. **Abductive move:** I infer that both fail because the whole arena remains under the authority they attempt to bypass. **Reading change:** the clause closes both long-term and emergency escape strategies.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:32-35 move from earth to open sea, then from motion to stillness, ruin, and no turning-place. That sequence confirmed that changing spatial arena cannot create escape; 42:36's reliance supplies the viable alternative to attempted outmaneuvering.

baseline.text: Siz yeryüzünde O'nu aciz bırakamazsınız. Allah'ın dışında ne bir dostunuz ne de bir yardımcınız vardır.

findings.text: Yeryüzünün genişliği bir kaçış alanı oluşturmaz; yer değiştirmek, her yeri kuşatan yetkiyi geride bırakmaya yetmez.
Allah dışında hem uzun süreli bağlılık desteği hem de kriz anındaki özel yardım kapanır; iki farklı kurtarma yolu birlikte reddedilir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It is the closest counterpart, extending the focus's inability to escape on earth to heaven while repeating the denial of any protector or helper apart from God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gives a concrete mode of unavoidable punishment on earth, making the focus's warning against escape more vivid.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats the denial of any protector or helper apart from God and grounds it in His dominion over heaven and earth.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It pairs the same denial of protector and helper with God's ownership of heaven and earth, though the central wording is already established.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Within the same passage it states that disputants have no escape, directly sharpening the focus's inescapability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It confirms the promised event as true and says its hearers cannot thwart it, adding certainty to the focus's warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins inability to escape on earth with having no protectors besides God, while locating the consequence in multiplied punishment.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its rule concerning response after wrongdoing does not clarify escape from God or the absence of divine alternatives.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It repeats that disbelievers cannot escape on earth but adds only their destination in the Fire after earlier direct parallels.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links the arrival of the threatened matter to God's will and denies the hearers any power to thwart it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It applies inability to escape on earth and lack of protectors to refusing God's caller, adding a response-to-revelation setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly denies the wrongdoers any allies to help them apart from God and adds that divine misguidance leaves no path out.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It affirms that the promised matter will come and cannot be thwarted, but lacks the focus's protector and earth framing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its contrast between worldly provision and what remains with God gives nearby trust context without developing the focus's warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It exposes those invoked apart from God as unable to help either their worshippers or themselves, explaining why no other help is available.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies the wrongdoers any protector or helper and frames that deprivation within God's will and mercy.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its account of resisting oppression concerns human response and does not illuminate the focus's divine inescapability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that those in lasting punishment find neither protector nor helper, a later judgment application of the focus's denial.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It says people cannot escape while moving about, but the same inability has already been stated more fully.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its legal authority for a murder victim's heir uses related terms in a distinct human legal context.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It associates striving to frustrate God's signs with painful punishment, a broad consequence parallel to the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies a protector or helper on earth in a specific account of hypocrites, but repeats an already well-established formula.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its praise of avoiding grave sins and forgiving anger does not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its challenge about why the condemned do not aid one another offers a brief judgment-scene contrast to divine help.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts God's encompassing favors with disputation without knowledge, giving only broad sovereignty context.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies wrongful oppression and transgression on earth as liable to painful punishment, supplying nearby consequence context.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its naming of God as Creator, Maker, and Fashioner supports broad sovereignty but not the focus's specific warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's independence from all who disbelieve on earth indirectly supports the futility of resisting Him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It questions what force could help people apart from the Merciful, directly challenging reliance on an alternative helper.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directs reliance and return to God while denying human power before Him, but in a distinct communal example.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's possession of all in heaven and earth supplies the sovereignty premise behind the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links efforts to frustrate God's signs with the Fire, repeating a broad punitive consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It warns that siding with wrongdoers leaves people without protectors apart from God and without help.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It affirms God's ownership of heaven and earth and the truth of His promise, but adds little after earlier ownership parallels.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Wrongdoing closes evasive exits while legitimate grievance opens a bounded avenue of recourse.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The ethical distinction is spatialized as a no-exit enclosure for evasion and an extended public road for lawful redress.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: No Evasive Exit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A pursued party cannot outrun reach, veer away, or find an opening in the enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: inability to elude pursuit `quranic:root_000985:B002/m01`; veering away or escaping `quranic:root_000378:B001/m01`; no-exit trap `quranic:root_000378:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: ع ج ز at 42:31; ح ي ص at 42:35.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Escape is tested as movement under pursuit. Inability becomes concrete when every turn remains inside the same enclosure and no lateral route leads out.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Wrongdoing closes evasive exits while legitimate grievance opens a bounded avenue of recourse.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Avenue for a Just Claim
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A wronged party enters an acknowledged road of redress grounded in a claim and bounded by the right violated.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: extended road or avenue `quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`; protector or ally `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`; victim's redress `quranic:root_001510:B002/m01`; grievance or claim `quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`; aggression beyond the limit `quranic:root_000138:B003/m01`; owned or established right `quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Recourse is not an escape hatch but an open civic way for a recognized grievance. Its legitimacy comes from the injured right and ends where redress would itself cross into aggression.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı bir şeyi yapacak güçten yoksun kalma, yetersiz kalma ve kararlı davranamama çevresinde kurar. Birini eylemden caydırma, onu yetersiz sayma ve erkek hayvanda çiftleşme gücünden yoksunluk da aynı çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, takip edilen birinin erişilemez olması veya bir şeyin arka bölümü anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel güç yetirememe çekirdeği ile caydırma, yetersiz sayma ve erkek hayvandaki çiftleşememe gibi biçime ya da söz öbeğine bağlı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi yapmaya gücü yetmemek, gereken yeterlikten geri kalmak ya da kararlı davranamamak. Bundan, birini eylemden alıkoyma veya yetersiz sayma ile erkek hayvanda çiftleşme gücünün bulunmaması gibi özel kullanımlar doğar.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi yapacak güce veya yeterli olanağa sahip olmama.
Gereken ölçüde kararlı davranamama ya da işi sürdürmede eksik kalma.
Birini isteksizleştirip eylemden alıkoyma veya onu yetersiz sayma.
Erkek hayvanın çiftleşmeye güç yetirememesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi güçsüzlük, yetersiz kalma ve eylemi gerçekleştirememe üzerindedir; kararlılık eksikliği, caydırma, yetersiz sayma ve çiftleşememe bunun özel görünümleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir eylemi gerçekleştirecek güç veya yeterliğin bulunmadığı genel çekirdeği karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Güç yokluğunu, eylem karşısındaki yetersizliği ve sonuçta geri kalmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir işi yapma gücünün bulunmadığı cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem ile yetersiz özne arasındaki doğrudan ilişkiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin eylemden alıkonduğu veya gücünün yetmediğinin ileri sürüldüğü türemiş kullanımlarda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem eylemi engelleme hem de yetersizlik yükleme yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Erkek insan veya hayvandaki cinsel güç yetersizliğini anlatan dar bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Katılımcıyı, işlevi ve güç yetersizliğini açıkça korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel bir yeterlik yokluğunu çekirdek edinir; komşu dal ise belirli işlevlerdeki kesilme ve cevap verememe görünümlerini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda temel sorun güç veya yeterlik yokluğudur; komşuda ise gevşeklik ve gereken çabayı göstermeme daha belirgindir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür eyleme ilişkin genel yetersizliği ve bunun başka türemiş kullanımlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnız erkek cinsel işlevindeki yetersizliği adlandıran dar bir alanla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal erkek cinsel işlevinin yerine getirilememesi bağlamında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal doğrudan cinsel işlev bozukluğuna ad verir; odak dalın bu bağlamı, daha genel güç yetirememe anlamının özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العجز عن الشيء، والقصور عن الفعل، ونقيض القدرة أو الحزم، والتعجيز بمعنى التثبيط أو النسبة إلى العجز، والعجز الجنسي في الفحل أو الرجل.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana çizgisi takip edilene yetişememe, onun öne geçmesi ve erişilemez olmasıdır. Yarışma, karşı koyma veya kaçabileceğini sanma yorumları bu çizginin bağlama bağlı çeşitleridir; güvenilen bir yere yönelme ise yalnız özel söz öbeğinde geçerli ayrı bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Erişilemez olma çekirdeği, öznenin genel güçsüzlüğüyle karıştırılmamalı; sığınağa yönelme kullanımı da bütün dala yayılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, takipten sıyrılma çekirdeğini biçime bağlı yarışma yorumlarından ve güvenilen bir yere yönelme söz öbeğinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Takip edilenin uzaklaşıp öne geçmesi yüzünden arayanın ona yetişememesi veya onu ele geçirememesi. Bazı biçimlerde yarışma, karşı koyma ya da kaçabileceğini sanma anlatılır; belirli bir söz öbeğinde ise güvenilen bir yere yönelme anlamı bulunur.

facets.statement: Takip edilenin uzaklaşarak arayan için erişilemez olması.
Öne geçme nedeniyle takipçinin yetişememesi ve aradığını elden kaçırması.
Belirli bir biçimin yarışanlar, karşı koyanlar veya kaçabileceklerini sananlar olarak yorumlanması.
Yalnız belirli söz öbeğinde güvenilir sayılan bir sığınağa yönelme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, birinin uzaklaşıp takipçisinin erişiminden çıkmasıdır. Yarışma ve karşı koyma yorumları kaçış ilişkisini farklı açılardan kurar; güvenilir bir yere yönelme ise kalıba bağlı olarak ayrı tutulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Takip edilenin öne geçerek veya uzaklaşarak arayanın erişiminden çıkmasını anlatan çekirdekte kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Takibi, taraflar arasındaki yönü, uzaklaşmayı ve erişilememe sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım takipçinin bakış açısından kurulduğunda ve aranan kişiye yetişilemediğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Takipçinin erişememesini ve arananın kaçması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlatım kaçan veya yarışan tarafın bakış açısından kurulduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Öne geçmeyi ve takipçinin erişiminden çıkmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız güvenilen bir yere veya tarafa yönelmeyi bildiren özel söz öbeğinde geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Yönelme hareketini ve hedefin güvenilir sığınak niteliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yarışma, karşı koyma ve güvenilir bir sığınağa yönelme gibi biçime bağlı yan kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kaçan tarafın takipçiyi aşması yanında takipçinin de aradığını yenip sonuçsuz bırakabilmesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeğinde takip edilenin yakalanamaması ve arayanın ona yetişememesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekler çok yakındır; odak dal biçime bağlı yarışma ve sığınağa yönelme kullanımlarını taşırken komşu dal yakalama ve üstün gelme ilişkisini daha geniş kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Takipçinin aradığını ele geçirememesi ve kaçanın erişilemez olması sonucunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atın, kuş yavrusunun veya ganimetle kaçanın bağımsız biçimde ilerlemesini ve kurtuluşunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda öne geçme yoluyla yakalanmaktan kurtulma anlamı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ilişkisel olarak bir takipçiyi sonuçsuz bırakmayı gerektirir; komşu dalda ilerleme ve kurtuluş daha geniş bir hareket alanına yayılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kaçan tarafın öne geçerek takipçiyi erişemez durumda bırakmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir rakipten geri çekilme, kaçma, yan çizme veya bir şeyden dönme hareketlerini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir karşılaşmadan uzaklaşma ve yakalanmama senaryosuna girebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal hareketin geri çekilme yönüne odaklanır; odak dal ise takipçinin yetişememesiyle oluşan ilişkisel sonucu zorunlu kılar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kaçan veya öne geçen tarafın başkasını kendisine erişemez durumda bırakmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir işi gerçekleştirecek güçten ve yeterlikten yoksun olan tarafın kendi durumunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir tarafın amacına ulaşamaması biçimsel olarak ortak görünür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal başarısızlığı kaçan tarafın uzaklaşmasına bağlar; komşu dal ise doğrudan eyleyenin güç veya yeterlik eksikliğini adlandırır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أعجزني إذا فاتني أو لم أدركه، ولا نعجز الله، ومعاجزين بمعنى مسابقين أو ظانين الإفلات، ويعاجز إلى ثقة بمعنى يميل أو يلجأ إليها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مجرد الضعف في القدرة، ولا مؤخر الجسم أو الشيء.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أعجزني فلان إذا عجزت عن طلبه وإدراكه (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib)؛ فلان عاجز فلانا إذا ذهب فلم يوصل إليه (maqayis)؛ عاجز فلان إذا ذهب فلم يقدر عليه (ayn;sihah)؛ معنى الإعجاز الفوت والسبق (tahdhib)؛ معاجزين تفسيره معاندين وقيل مسابقين (tahdhib)؛ معاجزين قيل ظانين ومقدرين أنهم يعجزوننا (mufradat)؛ إنه ليعاجز إلى ثقة إذا مال إليه (sihah;tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlarda ileri yaşı ve yaşlanmayı açıkça doğrular; yıllanmış içki bu çekirdeğin eskilik uzantısıdır. Kılıç namlusu veya kabza parçasına verilen ad ise bir açıklamada eskiliğe bağlansa da adlandırmanın kendisi kesin olarak yalnız bu gerekçeye indirgenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan yaşlılığı ile nesne eskiliği bağlantılı tutulmalı, kılıç parçasının adı ise kesin bir eskilik örneği gibi genelleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım insanın yaşlılığı çekirdeğini, yıllanmış içki kullanımını ve kılıç parçasına özgü adlandırmayı birbirinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Kadın veya erkeğin ileri yaşta olması ve bu duruma gelmesi; eskilik ilişkisiyle yıllanmış içkiye de aynı niteleme verilir. Kılıcın namlusu ya da kabzasındaki bir parça için kullanılan ad ise kaynaklarda yer alır, fakat eskilik bağı yalnız olası bir açıklamadır.

facets.statement: Kadın veya erkeğin ileri yaşta bulunması.
Bir kadının yaşlanarak ileri yaş durumuna gelmesi.
Uzun süre bekleyip yıllanmış içkinin eskilik yönüyle yaşlı sayılması.
Kılıç namlusu veya kabzadaki bir parçanın aynı adla anılması ve bunun eskiliğe bağlanmasının kesin olmaması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanın ileri yaşını ve yaşlanma sürecini ortak biçimde verir; yıllanmış içki eskilik uzantısıdır. Kılıç parçasına ilişkin adlandırma sabittir, ancak bu adın eskilikten geldiği açıklaması kesin değildir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsandaki ileri yaş çekirdeğini ve bundan nesnelere uzanan eskilik nitelemesini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan yaşlılığını, yaşlanmayı ve eskilik üzerinden kurulan ad aktarımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İleri yaştaki insanı cinsiyet ayrımı yapmadan adlandıran kullanımlarda uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kadının ileri yaş durumuna geçişini bildiren eylem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Durumdan çok ileri yaşa geçiş sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uzun süre beklemiş içkinin eskiliğini ve olgunlaşmışlığını anlatan bağlamda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: İçkinin zamanla eskimiş ve yıllanmış olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcın namlusuna ya da kabzasındaki belirli parçaya verilen özel adı açıklarken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kaynaklardaki iki parça yorumunu kesin bir köken iddiası eklemeden korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanın veya başka bir şeyin arka bölümünü temel alır; işlerin sonları ve develerin arka kısımları bu uzamın doğal genişlemeleridir. Kadının kalçası, kalçanın iri olması, devenin arkasına binme ve kalçayı iri gösteren dolgu da aynı arka bölüm çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız konumsal arka ve son bölümle ilgilidir; güç yetersizliği veya yaşlılık bu tanımın parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel arka bölüm çekirdeğini, son aşama uzantısını ve kadın kalçası ile deveye binmeye bağlı özel kullanımları ayrı gösterir.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın veya başka bir varlığın arka kısmı ve işlerin son bölümü. Bu konumdan kadının kalçası ve iriliği, devenin arka tarafına binme ve kalçayı iri gösteren dolgu gibi özel kullanımlar gelişir.

facets.statement: İnsanın veya herhangi bir şeyin önün karşısındaki arka bölümü.
Develerin arka kısımları ile işlerin son bölümleri.
Kadının kalçası ve kalçanın iri olması.
Devenin arka tarafına binme eylemi.
Kadının kalçasını iri göstermek için bağladığı yastık benzeri dolgu.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği insanın veya şeyin arka bölümüdür. Son bölüm, kadın kalçası, devenin arkasına binme ve görünüşü büyüten dolgu bu konumsal çekirdeğe bağlı genişleme ve özel kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli kum adlandırmalarını verir: dağ gibi yükselen fakat gevşek bir yığın olmayan kum sırtı, bitki yetişmesine elverişli yüksek kum oluşumu ve belirli bir çöl yöresindeki özel adlı kum tepesi. Arka beden benzerliği açıklayıcıdır, genel arka bölüm anlamı değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız verilen kum söz öbekleriyle sınırlıdır; her kum tepesi veya her yüksek arazi için genel bir ad sayılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kaynakta verilen kum söz öbeklerine bağlanır ve bu kullanımlardan yalın kök için genel bir arazi anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz öbeklerinde, dağ gibi yükselen fakat gevşekçe yığılmış olmayan, bitki yetişmesine elverişli kum sırtı veya yüksek kum tepesi. Aynı adlandırma belirli bir çöl yöresindeki özel adlı bir kum tepesi için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Yalnız belirli kum söz öbeğinde dağ gibi yükselen kum sırtı veya kum tepesi.
Gevşek bir kum yığını olmayan ve bitki yetişmesine elverişli yüksek oluşum.
Belirli bir çöl yöresinde özel adla anılan kum tepesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek kum sırtı veya tepesi niteliğinde birleşir; bazı ayrıntılar bunun gevşek bir yığın olmadığını ve bitki yetişmesine elverişli olduğunu belirtir. Ayrıca belirli bir yöredeki özel adlı kum tepesi de aynı toplu kanıtta yer alır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal uzun ya da yüksek bir arazi biçimini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal biçimsel uzanımı farklı varlıklara yayar; odak dalın kapsamı belirli kum adlandırmalarıyla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yükseklik, gevşek yığın olmama ve bitki yetişmesine elverişlilik özellikleriyle belirlenir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kum tepesinin eğri, yatık veya yay biçiminde olmasını belirleyici özellik yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kumdan oluşan belirgin bir tepe veya sırtı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırt edici yönü yükseklik ve yerleşik söz öbeğidir; komşu dalın ayırt edici yönü eğrilik ve yay biçimidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kum sırtının uzunluk, yükseklik, genel arazi uzanımı ve eğrilik özellikleriyle sınırını gösteren dört aday seçildi.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العجزاء من الرمل، الرملة المرتفعة أو الحبل المرتفع المكرم للنبت، والرملة المسماة العجوز بالدهناء.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو عجز الإنسان أو المرأة إلا من جهة التشبيه، ولا ضعف القدرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العجزاء من الرمل رملة مرتفعة كأنها جبل (maqayis)؛ العجزاء من الرمل خاصة رملة مرتفعة كأنها جبل ليس بركام رمل وهي مكرمة المنبت (ayn)؛ العجزاء رملة مرتفعة (sihah)؛ العجوز رملة بالدهناء (sihah)؛ العجزاء من الرمال حبل مرتفع كأنه جلد ليس بركام رمل وهو مكرمة للنبت (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir belirti ya da hastalık değil, hayvan ve kuşların arka bölümüne ilişkin üç ayrı kalıplaşmış kullanımı bir araya getirir: binek hayvanının arkasını tutan hastalık, kartala verilen tartışmalı niteleme ve kuşun arka parmağının adı. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu ayrımlar tek bir ortak belirti gibi sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hastalık, kartal niteliği ve kuşun arka parmağı ayrı söz öbeklerine bağlıdır; birinin özellikleri ötekine aktarılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız üç tanıklı söz öbeğini kapsar; bunlardan yalın biçime ait genel bir hayvan ya da arka bölüm anlamı çıkarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Hayvanların arka bölümüne ilişkin üç ayrı kalıplaşmış adlandırma: binek hayvanının arka kısmını tutup onu ağırlaştıran hastalık, yorumu kaynaklara göre değişen bir kartal niteliği ve kuşun arka parmağı. Kartal niteliği hafif arka bölüm, güçlü arka parmak veya pençe, kısa kuyruk ya da kuyruktaki bir iki beyaz tüy biçiminde açıklanır.

facets.statement: Binek hayvanının arka kısmını tutarak hareketini ağırlaştıran hastalık.
Kartalın hafif arka bölümü, güçlü arka parmağı veya pençesi, kısa kuyruğu ya da kuyruğundaki bir iki beyaz tüyle açıklanan tartışmalı nitelik.
Kuşun geriye dönük arka parmağına verilen ad.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt hayvanın arka bölgesi çevresinde üç kalıplaşmış kullanımı birleştirir. Hastalık ve arka parmak açıkça ayrılır; kartal nitelemesinin hafif arka bölüm, güçlü arka parmak veya pençe, kısa kuyruk ya da beyaz kuyruk tüyü olarak açıklanmasında görüş ayrılığı vardır.

concept_gloss.text: arka bölüm hastalığı, kartal niteliği ve kuşun arka parmağı
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kaynakta verilen üç hayvan ve kuş söz öbeğini, birbirine karıştırmadan topluca temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı kullanımı, hayvanın arka bölgesi ortaklığını ve kartal nitelemesindeki görüş ayrılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Binek hayvanını arka tarafından etkileyip ağırlaştıran hastalıktan söz edilirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hastalığı, etkilenen arka bölümü ve hayvanı ağırlaştıran sonucu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuyruk, arka beden veya arka pençe özelliklerinden biriyle nitelenen kartalı genel olarak açıklarken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kartal katılımcısını, arka bölüm ortaklığını ve niteliğin tek yoruma indirgenmemesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuş ayağındaki geriye dönük parmağın özel adı açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuşu, anatomik parçayı ve parçanın arka konumunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: binek hayvanının arka kısmını tutup ağırlaştıran hastalık

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Binek hayvanının arka kısmındaki hastalık yanında iki ayrı kuş adlandırmasını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koyunun sırtında görülen ve sırtla sınırlı olan başka bir hastalığı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hayvanın gövdesinin arka tarafına yakın bir bölgeyi tutan hastalıkları adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın hastalığı binek hayvanının arka kısmındadır; komşu dal koyunun sırtındaki hastalıktır ve kuşlara ilişkin kullanımları yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Arka kısmı tutan hastalık ile kartal ve kuş parmağı adlandırmalarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Devenin sırt omurlarındaki bozukluğu veya kalçalarındaki ağırlık yüzünden kalkamamasını niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hayvanın sırt veya kalça çevresindeki bozukluk ve ağırlık alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal doğrudan devedeki yapısal kusuru niteler; odak dalın hastalık kullanımı daha genel bir binek hayvanının arka kısmını tutan rahatsızlıktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kuşun geriye dönük parmağını ve başka arka bölüm kullanımlarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: At veya başka bir binek hayvanında tırnak beyazlığını ve bacak kemiklerinin birleşme yerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hayvan ayağındaki belirli anatomik parçaları veya işaretleri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kuşun arka parmağına yönelir; komşu dal binek hayvanının tırnak rengi ve bacak birleşim yeriyle ilgilidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; hastalık, arka gövde kusuru ve ayak parçası alanlarında gerçek sınır karşılaştırması sağlayan üç komşu yayımlandı.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو عجز الإنسان ولا الرمل المرتفع إلا من جهة المؤخر أو الشبه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العجز داء يأخذ الدابة في عجزها (maqayis;ayn)؛ العجزاء من العقبان الخفيفة العجيزة (maqayis)؛ عقاب عجزاء اختلفوا في تفسيره (jamhara)؛ إذا كان في ذنبها ريشة بيضاء أو ريشتان (jamhara;tahdhib)؛ عقاب عجزاء للقصيرة الذنب (sihah)؛ العجزاء الشديدة الدابرة والشديدة الكف (jamhara)؛ يقال لدابرة الطائر العجازة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir erkeğin, kadının veya anne babanın çocukları arasındaki son çocuğu adlandırır. Anne babanın ileri yaşında doğmuş olma bazı tanıklarda özel bir vurgu olarak bulunur; son çocuk çekirdeği için her kullanımda zorunlu koşul değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çocuklar arasındaki son çocukla sınırlıdır; ileri yaştaki ebeveynden doğma yalnız özel vurgu olabilir, yaşlı kişinin kendisini veya herhangi bir dizinin sonunu anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yerleşik son çocuk anlamını ileri yaştaki ebeveynden doğma vurgusu taşıyan özel kullanımdan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir erkeğin, kadının veya anne babanın çocukları arasındaki son çocuk. Anne babası ileri yaştayken doğmuş olması bazı kullanımlarda özel bir vurgu olarak bulunur.

facets.statement: Bir erkeğin, kadının veya anne babanın çocukları arasındaki son çocuk.
Anne babası ileri yaşa geldikten sonra doğmuş olan son çocuk.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar son çocuk olma üzerinde birleşir; bazı tanıklıklar bunu yaşlı erkek, yaşlı kadın ya da ileri yaştaki iki ebeveyn üzerinden ayrıca özelleştirir. İleri yaşta doğmuş olma, bütün kullanımların belirleyici koşulu değil bazı kaynaklarda öne çıkan özel vurgudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Anne veya babanın ileri yaşında dünyaya gelen ve kardeşler arasında son sırada bulunan çocuğu karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuk katılımcısını, son sırayı ve ebeveynlerin ileri yaşı koşulunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ebeveynlerin ileri yaşı bağlamdan zaten belliyken kardeşler arasındaki son sırayı doğal biçimde anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Aile ilişkisini ve kardeşler arasındaki son çocuk olmayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Ebeveynlerin ileri yaşında doğmuş olma koşulunu tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Son sırayı ve ebeveynlerin ileri yaşını açıkça belirtmek gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ebeveynleri, ileri yaş koşulunu ve son çocuk olmayı eksiksiz korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yaşlı anne veya babanın son çocuğu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çocuğun kardeşler arasında son olması çekirdeğini ve bazı kullanımlarda anne babasının ileri yaşında doğması vurgusunu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çocuğu ve kuşakların birbirinden üremesini genel olarak, sıra veya ebeveyn yaşı koşulu olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal çocuk ve anne babadan gelen soy ilişkisi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal her türlü çocuk ve çoğalmayı kapsar; odak dal çocuklar arasındaki son çocuğu adlandırır ve bazı kullanımlarda ileri yaştaki ebeveyn vurgusu taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan ailesinde son sırayı belirleyici yapar; ebeveynlerin ileri yaşı bazı kullanımlarda özel vurgudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvan yavrusunun annesini izlemesini veya yavruların annelerine bağlı ilerlemesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal çocuk ya da yavrunun anneyle ilişkisini ve ardından gelme düşüncesini paylaşabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğum sırasındaki sonluğu bildirir; komşu dal ise doğmuş yavrunun annesini fiziksel olarak izlemesine odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çocuğun doğum sırasındaki sonluğunu ve bazı kullanımlarda doğduğu sırada ebeveynlerin ileri yaşını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çocuğun büyüyerek babasıyla arkadaş sayılabilecek yaşa gelmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal ebeveyn ile çocuk arasındaki ilişkinin yaşa bağlı bir görünümünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ebeveynin yaşı ve çocuğun doğum sırasıyla ilgilidir; komşu dal çocuğun sonradan yetişkinliğe erişmesini anlatır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العجزة وابن العجزة وآخر ولد الرجل أو المرأة أو الشيخ، والولد بعد كبر أبويه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو العجوز نفسها ولا مجرد آخر الشيء العام إلا في هذه الصيغة الخاصة.

root_profile.summary: Kök, güç yetirememeden takipçiyi sonuçsuz bırakacak biçimde uzaklaşmaya; insan yaşlılığından arka ve son bölüm adlarına uzanan çok anlamlı bir yapı gösterir. Arka bölüm benzerliği kum ve hayvan adlandırmalarına yayılır; çocuklar arasındaki son çocuk dalı da bazı kullanımlarda ileri yaştaki ebeveyn vurgusu taşır.
